craft_notes: Sthāyin: Love pleading through dread (rati under fear). Em-dash→comma (thriving softens onto bristling). Rejected: 'swell' for 'thrive' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Thrive the lays whose lay is the Lofty One,
at whose mere name the mighty bristle bright.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Victorious songs whose singable is the supreme lord. → Songs of the supreme lord conquer, thrilling great souls.
c1_essence: Hymns singing the high one thrill the great at his bare name.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)

l2.plain_english: Long live the hymns that sing the high lord — at whose bare name the great break out in bristling thrill.
l2.sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

l3: Thrive the lays whose lay is the Lofty One —
at whose mere name the mighty bristle bright.
reads_against.t1: Victorious are songs whose singable is the supreme lord — by whose name even great souls are sown with thrill-sprouts.
